'''Quentel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quara/Legends|Quara]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Quentel became a member of a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] crew but shortly afterward, the freighter was captured by [[The Scourge]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group that operated in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. Quentel attempted to escape and he failed, but the pirates were impressed by the engineering skills that Quentel demonstrated during his escape attempt and he was invited to become a member of their organization. He eventually became the second-in-command of The Scourge and he spent four months installing a [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]] in the pirates' [[Super Transport VII]] container [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Impasse]]'', which he considered to be his finest engineering achievement. Quentel later [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the ''Impasse'' during a Scourge attack on a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] starship near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alluuvia]].
